prs.title: feat(flags): AI Alliances Assistant company feature flag (SM-648–651)
prs.author: Jason
prs.rationale: Adds a new company-level feature flag end-to-end across 16 files — schema migration, DAL update, admin toggle UI, server action, and conditional rendering in multiple app routes and components — representing a significant cross-cutting change despite being additive only.

prs.title: SM-544: Rename EDP to PPA in prospect enrichment
prs.author: Jason
prs.rationale: A focused rename of EDP to PPA across agent code, prompts, schema, UI, tests, and docs — modest scope with no new logic introduced.

prs.title: Sm 580 579 confetti and recap
prs.author: Mauro
prs.rationale: Introduces two distinct user-facing features — confetti celebration on task completion and a login recap modal — each with custom hooks, providers, components, sandbox pages, and integration into the guided experience flow, totalling substantial novel UI/UX work across 16 files.

prs.title: SM-658: updates collector to use aws service identifiers
prs.author: Chris
prs.rationale: Significant refactor converting AWS product handling to service identifiers across collectors, field definitions, schema migrations, portfolio CSV export, aggregation logic, AI prompts, and tests — 22 commits touching 18 files with substantial architectural changes to data modelling and downstream consumers.

prs.title: fix(ace): associate Marketplace products/solutions instead of Other (SM-629)
prs.author: Jason
prs.rationale: Major ACE integration enhancement spanning two schema migrations, new Marketplace product/solution ARN modelling, mapper logic, enums, field definitions, prospect editor UI, sync logic, and sandbox validation tooling across 22 files — a meaningful architectural addition to the ACE data layer.

prs.title: feat(deployment): send Cognito email from no-reply@skematic.ai via SES
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: Sets up SES domain verification, DKIM, and Cognito email sender configuration via new Terraform module files and a wait script — meaningful infrastructure work requiring SES/Cognito integration knowledge across multiple environments.

prs.title: fix(deployment): grant stagingx ECS tasks Redis access (missing SG ingress)
prs.author: Chad
prs.rationale: Small targeted fix adding a missing security group ingress rule for Redis access in the stagingx environment across three Terraform files.

stories.name: AI Alliances Assistant Launch Readiness
stories.rationale: Introduced a company-level feature flag to control access to the new AI Alliances Assistant, enabling controlled rollout to customers.

stories.name: Prospect Enrichment Data Rebranding
stories.rationale: Renamed the EDP identifier to PPA across prospect enrichment to reflect updated business terminology.

stories.name: Assessment Completion Celebration & Recap Experience
stories.rationale: Added confetti animation and a recap summary screen to reward and orient users upon completing an assessment.

stories.name: AWS Service Identifier Standardization for Data Collection
stories.rationale: Updated the data collector to use official AWS service identifiers, ensuring accurate and consistent cloud data ingestion.

stories.name: AWS Marketplace Product Association Fix
stories.rationale: Fixed the ACE integration to correctly associate Marketplace products and solutions rather than defaulting to 'Other', improving co-sell accuracy.

stories.name: Email & Infrastructure Reliability Improvements
stories.rationale: Configured Cognito to send emails from a branded no-reply address via SES and resolved a missing Redis security group rule blocking staging environment tasks.
